cohort: The study included 630 pregnancies (577 spontaneous and 53 assisted) in women with systemic lupus erythematosus enrolled in the multicentre French GR2 study, with available end-of-pregnancy data.
finding: Fertility treatments in women with mostly well-controlled systemic lupus erythematosus did not appear to increase the risks of maternal or neonatal complications, including live birth rates, disease flares, or adverse pregnancy outcomes, compared to spontaneous pregnancies.
followup_time: Up to the end of pregnancy/birth
